notes.title: Patch 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
- Fixed hero notifications on new missions (you can play Rufus and Kara in Battle mode)
- Fixed nighttime overriding the frozen lake event
- Changed icemoster roll to prevent weird behaviour
- Fixed chariots lagging behind in big armies.
- Fixed buildings spawning the right ruins when destroyed in campaign mode
- You can target neutral structures correctly again
- Corrected objectives in mission 9

Gameplay changes:
- Increased the difficulty of missions 9 and 10
- Slightly increased overall aggressiveness of Normal and Easy AI
- Troops now get chilled before taking damage from water in mission 10

Visual changes:
- Reduced health size of turrets
- Ghost Rufus now completely disappears after dying.

notes.title: Army movement update +bugfixes.
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone, I made some changes to the pathfinding which especially affects huge armies.[/b] 
Armies stick to the correct formation far better and form a correct formation no matter its size. Their movement around obstacles is also improved.

[b]Other fixes included in this patch:[/b]
- Fixed buttons from overlapping in niche situations.
- Fixed an error when pausing while placing troops in the Testing Grounds.
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't beat mission one when clearing the nomads with non-hero troops.
- Buildings were incorrectly targeting flying troops.
- Fixed mortars load animation.
- AI now sends neutral crossbowman from the crossbowcamp (Battle mode, King of the Hill map) to attack now and then.

notes.title: Heroes update
notes.notes:
[h1]Heroes join the battle![/h1]

[b]Heroes[/b] are unique characters that can be leveled during the game to unlock [b]powerful abilities[/b].

[previewyoutube=8HrS6K3QpQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Currently [b]two heroes[/b] have been added to the demo, more will follow:

[b]Lieutenant Moss:[/b] A Monceaux [b]brawler[/b] hero who specializes in various weapon combat arts.
- Ability 1: Spear throw, a heavy damage range attack.
- Ability 2: Shield, Moss gains a huge defense boost.
- Ability 3: Mace flurry, a heavy area damage melee attack.

[b]Alyssa the Shaman:[/b] A Fahadian [b]ranger[/b] hero with high mobility and the power of sand.
- Ability 1: Leadership, a movement and attack speed buff for nomads and sand troops around her.
- Ability 2: Piercing shots, Alyssa fires arrows with increased penetration and attack speed.
- Ability 3: Tornado, summons a tornado that redirects enemy projectiles.

During Next Fest the second faction, [b]the Fahad, is available for play[/b], so don't miss it and let me know what you think here or in the discord: https://discord.gg/8bNMBkr7te


This update also includes a ton of bug fixes and gameplay improvements. 
- Various unit improvements, mainly the Dust Devil (Fahad) and the Chariot (Monceaux) are a lot stronger and more player-friendly.
- Various crashes are removed.
- Troops now react better than ever to your commands.
- Big armies no longer form one long line, but can stand next to each other.
- Performance is improved even further.
- Various tips are included in the tip system.
- Improvements to worker management.
- Improved info on troops and buildings through an info system and better descriptions.
- Multiple buildings can be selected at once and buildings of the same type can have units trained simultaneously.

I hope you're having a blast, Cheers!
